WristTemperatureSampleAdditionalNote.target: The exported Wrist Temperature data is a distilled version of the data that was captured. Hardware and algorithm specific information is omitted, and multichannel signals are condensed into a single de-noised value.

ECGSampleAdditionalNote.target: The exported ECG data is a distilled version of the data that was captured. Hardware and algorithm specific information is omitted, and multichannel signals are condensed into a single de-noised waveform.

faceMetricsReminderMessage.target: Study data captured by your camera this week will be submitted soon. Learn more in Settings.

SRErrorNoAuthorization.target: Insufficient authorization to perform the action

SRErrorNoAuthorizationRecovery.target: User should authorize data collection for this app

PPGSampleAdditionalNote.target: The data exported from the optical sensor (PPG data) is a distilled version of the data that was captured. Hardware and algorithm specific information is omitted, and multichannel signals are condensed into a single de-noised waveform. Also note that in some cases, accelerometer-derived metrics may also be collected alongside PPG data. Please refer to the accelerometer data export for that data.
